subject: Proposal: domain ownership redistribution & comms schedule
messages:
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: domain ownership redistribution & comms schedule

Team —

After the last few cross-pod incidents and the customer feedback from Acme, I sketched a lightweight proposal to redistribute domain ownership (compute, model onboarding, and infra observability) across three domain leads instead of the current four. The goals are to reduce handoffs for low-latency paths and consolidate ownership for the model lifecycle components that frequently cross teams.

High-level summary (attached: ownership-heatmap-v1.xlsx):
- Create Domain A: Inference Runtime & Runtime Ops (merge pieces from current Runtime and Edge teams).
- Create Domain B: Model Onboarding & Validation (bring model ops and quality evaluation under one lead).
- Create Domain C: Platform Integrations & Observability (API surface + tracing/costing).

Proposed role changes (brief):
- Move two senior ICs from Runtime into Domain A as principal engineers (no headcount change).
- Re-scope one manager role into a senior program manager for cross-domain SLAs.
- Preserve product manager pairings for each domain.

Requesting review on three things by EOD Wednesday:
1) Operational risks we’re missing (Laura).
2) HR/process implications for title/scope changes and the one manager conversion (Monica).
3) Customer-facing comms cadence for impacted accounts — I started a draft (Aditya).

Thanks — I appreciate quick feedback so we can iterate before the exec sync on Thursday.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ownership-heatmap-v1.xlsx

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: domain ownership redistribution & comms schedule

Markus —

Thanks for the concise draft. A few immediate concerns from an operational standpoint:

- Runbooks & escalation: merging Runtime and Edge pieces will require at least two-week focused work to reconcile on-call playbooks and SLO ownership. We should not flip ownership without a clear rollover checklist.
- Customer SLAs: Acme and two other Tier-1 customers have bespoke routing rules that currently cross both Runtime and Integrations. We need to confirm the comms plan covers temporary routing exceptions.
- Manager conversion: converting a manager role to a program manager will affect direct reports and promotion paths; let's identify which reports would need regrading.

I suggest we add a phased timeline section to the comm plan: Week 0 (announce), Weeks 1–2 (runbook consolidation), Weeks 3–6 (pilot for two accounts), Week 7 (full rollout).

I attached a quick checklist in the Drive link with the items I think are non-negotiable.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Reliability & Platform

Quoted below: "On Sun, 21 Mar 2027 at 09:12, markus_klein@redwood.ai wrote: ..."
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: domain ownership redistribution & comms schedule

Laura —

Good points. I agree we need a phased timeline and explicit rollbacks. I updated the heatmap with a pilot window and included an outline for runbook handoffs. Key clarifications:

- Pilot accounts: Acme (Tier-1) and Finch Labs (Tier-2) — two-week pilot each, staggered.
- On-call: we keep both existing on-call rotations for two weeks during the pilot, then transition primary paging to Domain A with Domain C as secondary.
- Manager conversion: the manager impacted is currently attached to Runtime; the intention is to convert that role to a senior program manager focusing on SLAs and runbook hygiene, while the direct reports remain ICs with unchanged levels. Monica — please flag HR/comp implications and if we need a formal performance conversation for the manager role as part of the change.

Aditya — can you take a first pass at customer comms that includes the pilot dates and an opt-in window for customers who want a more conservative rollout? I put a stub in comm-plan-draft.pdf.

Thanks — will fold your checklist into the Week 0/1 work.

— Markus

Attachments: comm-plan-draft.pdf
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: domain ownership redistribution & comms schedule

Markus/Laura —

HR perspective — short summary of what needs to be in place before any title/scope change or manager conversion:

1) Performance justification memo for the manager conversion (internal doc) — this should include goals of the new PM role, expected metrics, and a compensation recommendation.
2) Career conversation plan for the manager and three direct reports (script + timeline).
3) Updated org chart + reporting lines to be published with the announcement.
4) Any changes to compensation/pay band must route through Talent Comp — allow 7 business days for review.

On confidentiality: please do not include the manager's name in the earliest draft announcement. Instead, announce role-level changes and the pilot timeline; offer 1:1s for directly impacted folks. We should also prepare a short FAQ to avoid rumors.

I can draft the perf memo and the 1:1 script — give me until Friday COB.

— Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Talent Operations

Team —

Thanks for moving quickly. A couple of exec-level asks before the Thursday leadership sync:

- Risks & mitigations: a one-page summary of the top 3 risks (customer impact, on-call coverage regressions, people morale) and concrete mitigations.
- Financial/comp impact: Monica, please surface any comp risks from the manager conversion for leadership.
- Customer comms: include a short optional FAQ for Tier-1 customers (Acme being first) explaining what the pilot means for them and how they can opt out.

Markus — please consolidate the heatmap + pilot timeline + Laura's checklist into a single slide (3 bullets per slide) and share a final link to the Drive before the exec meeting.

I'll be on the call Thursday and will push for a pilot approval if we have the checklist and the risk memo.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Chief Product Officer
